derivation: LIFE-007 separates the two clocks. Renewal eligibility uses the latest retained available lifecycle clock for the permit source, which is at the prior permit's exclusive expiry, so the result is not PREREQUISITE_MISSING. TIME-006 requires the submitted unavailable status to be consistent with retained time. An explicit later UNAVAILABLE lifecycle clock is retained after the available sample established renewal eligibility, so the new unavailable authority input produces ordinary admitted withholding without contradicting the latest sample. AUTH-005 cannot establish permission without a current clock. The lifecycle clock revision is null, which LIFE-007 permits only on an authority-withheld proposal whose selected clock is unavailable. The prior permit and reservation remain unextended and unsuperseded.
